code.title: Welcome to Nido
code.lead: To prove you are the one installing Nido, enter the setup code written in the server's logs. On the machine, run:

admin.title: Your administrator account
admin.lead: It can change every setting and invite the other members.
admin.username_too_short: A username is at least 3 characters.
admin.username_too_long: A username is at most 50 characters.
admin.password_too_short: A password is at least 8 characters.
admin.password_weak: Use at least one capital letter, one digit and one special character.
admin.confirm_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

address.title: Nido's address
address.lead: The address members will type to open Nido. The links in emails start with it.
address.invalid: Enter the address of the server, with no path after the name, such as https://nido.example.com.
address.http_warning: Without HTTPS, passwords and links travel in clear on the network. The README explains how to turn HTTPS on.
address.locked: This address is set by the server's configuration (NIDO_APP_URL).

mail.title: Email, if you wish
mail.lead: With a sending server, Nido can send forgotten-password links, invitations and notifications. You can also do this later from the settings.
mail.locked: Email is set by the server's configuration.
mail.test_sent: Test email sent to {{recipient}}. Check the inbox, and the spam folder.

key.title: Your encryption key
key.lead: Nido made this key to encrypt two-factor authentication, finances and the calendar. Without it, that data is lost: keep it in a password manager, away from your database backups. It will never be shown again.
key.provided: Your encryption key comes from the server's configuration: keep it safe, as you already do.
key.copy_failed: This browser could not copy the key: select it above to copy it, or download it.
key.saved: I have put this key somewhere safe

file.title: Nido encryption key
file.protects: It encrypts two-factor authentication, finances and the calendar. Without it, that data is lost.
file.where: Keep it in a password manager, away from your database backups.

done.title: Nido is ready
done.lead: Open Nido at its address to sign in:

errors.code_invalid: This is not the code written in the logs. Check it: it changes at every restart.
errors.code_changed: Nido restarted meanwhile: enter the new code from the logs. Your answers are kept.
errors.admin_refused: The server refused this account: the username is 3 to 50 characters, without @.
errors.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.network: The server does not answer. Check that it is still running.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
errors.key_not_saved: Confirm that the key is somewhere safe.
